quotes.author: Will Rogers

quotes.quote: All writers should be put in a box and thrown in the sea.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley

quotes.quote: writing about a writer's block is better than not writing at all
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  The Last Night of the Earth Poems

quotes.quote: Look, don't just stare at the pages,"I used to tell my students. "Become the characters. Live inside the book.

quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: We swallowed the chaos because we knew we didn't want to be ordinary.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: It took me fifteen years to discover that I had no talent for writing, but I couldn't give it up because by that time I was too famous.
quotes.author: Robert Benchley

quotes.quote: The best fame is a writer's fame. It's enough to get a table at a good restaurant, but not enough to get you interrupted when you eat.
quotes.author: Fran Lebowitz

quotes.quote: Writing novels is much the same. You gather up bones and make your gate, but no matter how wonderful the gate might be, that alone doesn't make it a living breathing novel. quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Sputnik Sweetheart

quotes.quote: There are a thousand thoughts lying within a man that he does not know till he takes up the pen to write.
quotes.author: William Makepeace Thackeray,  The History of Henry Esmond, Esq.

quotes.quote: Isn't it mysterious to begin a new journal like this? I can run my fingers through the fresh clean pages but I cannot guess what the writing on them will be.
quotes.author: Maud Hart Lovelace,  Betsy in Spite of Herself

quotes.quote: CALVIN:Our hero regains consciousness at the feet of a sarcastic alien.
quotes.author: Bill Watterson

quotes.author: Alan Moore

quotes.quote: But dear, don't be afraid of love it's only magic.

quotes.quote: Imagination is what you do with your inspiration.
quotes.author: Violet Haberdasher

quotes.quote: If it's fiction, then it better be true.

quotes.quote: True literature can exist only where it is created, not by diligent and trustworthy functionaries, but by madmen, hermits, heretics, dreamers, rebels, and skeptics.

quotes.author: Jasper Fforde,  The Eyre Affair

quotes.author: Vladimir Nabokov

quotes.quote: I write to understand as much as to be understood.
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  A Room of One's Own

quotes.quote: Books choose their authors; the act of creation is not entirely a rational and conscious one.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie

quotes.author: Joseph Campbell,  The Hero's Journey: Joseph Campbell on His Life & Work

quotes.author: Helvy Tiana Rosa

quotes.quote: I am the perfect version of me.
quotes.author: Besa Kosova

quotes.quote: She doesn't quite chop his head off.She makes a Pez dispenser out of him.

quotes.author: Bruce Wayne Sullivan

quotes.quote: They say living well is the best revenge but sometimes writing well is even better.
quotes.author: James Franco

quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Green Gables

quotes.author: E.L. Doctorow

quotes.quote: At that moment, the urge to be writing was stronger than any notion she had of what she might write.
quotes.author: Ian McEwan,  Atonement

quotes.quote: ...when writing, always hook the reader with your first sentence...in love, never settle...value yourself first and this will help you to value others...life is short, so enjoy it to the fullest...everyone in the world is different, and that's ok...
quotes.author: Spider Robinson

quotes.quote: Maybe the hardest thing in writing is simply to tell the truth about things as we see them.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck

quotes.quote: The good writing of any age has always been the product of someone's neurosis, and we'd have a mighty dull literature if all the writers that came along were a bunch of happy chuckleheads.
quotes.author: William Styron

quotes.quote: You may not be able to change the world, but at least you can embarrass the guilty.
quotes.author: Jessica Mitford

quotes.quote: He looked rather pleasantly, like a blonde satan.
quotes.author: Dashiell Hammett,  The Maltese Falcon

quotes.quote: To have the beginning of a truly great story, you need to have a character you're completely and utterly obsessed with. Without obsession, to the point of a maddening addiction,there's no point to continue.
quotes.author: Jennifer Salaiz

quotes.quote: Exercise the writing muscle every day, even if it is only a letter, notes, a title list, a character sketch, a journal entry. Writers are like dancers, like athletes. Without that exercise, the muscles seize up.
quotes.author: Jane Yolen

quotes.quote: Digression is the soul of wit. Take the philosophic asides away from Dante, Milton or Hamlet's father's ghost and what stays is dry bones.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

quotes.quote: . . . All artists' work is autobiographical. Any writer's work is a map of their psyche. You can really see what their concerns are, what their obsessions are, and what interests them.
quotes.author: Kim Addonizio

quotes.quote: Virtually every writer I know would rather be a musician.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: Don't you wish you had a job like mine? All you have to do is think up a certain number of words! Plus, you can repeat words! And they don't even have to be true!
quotes.author: Dave Barry

quotes.quote: One can be absolutely truthful and sincere even though admittedly the most outrageous liar.
quotes.author: Henry Miller

quotes.quote: I...have always known that my destiny was, above all, a literary destiny -- that bad things and some good things would happen to me, but that, in the long run, all of it would be convertedinto words. Particularly the bad things, since happiness does not need to be transformed: happiness is its own end.
quotes.author: Jorge Luis Borges,  Seven Nights

quotes.quote: A letter is always better than a phone call. People write things in letters they would never say in person. They permit themselves to write down feelings and observations using emotional syntax far more intimate and powerful than speech will allow.
quotes.author: Alice Steinbach,  Educating Alice: Adventures of a Curious Woman

quotes.quote: Being a writer is a good, good thing.
quotes.author: Shannon Hale

quotes.quote: Writing about music is like dancing about architecture - it's really a stupid thing to want to do.
quotes.author: Elvis Costello

quotes.quote: What is the purpose of writing? For me personally, it is really to explain the mystery of life, and the mystery of life includes, of course, the personal, the political, the forces that make us what we are while there's another force from inside battling to make us something else.
quotes.author: Nadine Gordimer

quotes.quote: In the end, fiction is the craft of telling truth through lies.
quotes.author: Lauren Groff

quotes.quote: one does not only wish to be understood when one writes; one wishes just as surely not to be understood.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: A good book isn't written, it's rewritten.
quotes.author: Phyllis A. Whitney,  Guide to Fiction Writing

quotes.quote: I write because I must. It's not a choice or a pastime, it's an unyeilding calling and my passion.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Reyes

quotes.quote: An author in his book must be like God in the universe, present everywhere and visible nowhere.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: Write,' she said, 'as if you'll never be read. That way you'll be sure to tell the truth.
quotes.author: Lori Lansens,  The Girls

quotes.quote: A person who publishes a book willfully appears before the populace with his pants down. If it is a good book nothing can hurt him. If it is a bad book nothing can help him.
quotes.author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

quotes.quote: Read everything. Read fiction and non-fiction, read hot best sellers and the classics you never got around to in college.
quotes.author: Jennifer Weiner

quotes.quote: Writing is really a way of thinking--not just feeling but thinking about things that are disparate, unresolved, mysterious, problematic or just sweet.
quotes.author: Toni Morrison

quotes.quote: Even bad books are books and therefore sacred.
quotes.author: GÃ¼nter Grass,  The Tin Drum

quotes.quote: It's funny, for all it took was a broken heart and that alone was enough, enough for her to do everything she ever dreamed of.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: The first thing you have to know about writing is that it is something you must do everyday. There are two reasons for this rule: Getting the work done and connecting with your unconscious mind.
quotes.author: Walter Mosley

quotes.quote: So much for endings. Beginnings are always more fun. True connoisseurs, however, are known to favor the stretch in between, since it's the hardest to do anything with. That's about all that can be said for plots, which anyway are just one thing after another, a what and a what and a what.
quotes.author: Margaret Atwood

quotes.quote: Stranger, pause and look;From the dust of agesLift this little book,Turn the tattered pages,Read me, do not let me die!Search the fading letters findingSteadfast in the broken bindingAll that once was I!
quotes.author: Edna St. Vincent Millay,  Collected Poems

quotes.quote: Writing is a dying form. One reads of this every day.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket

quotes.quote: Inspiration comes of working every day.
quotes.author: Charles Baudelaire

quotes.quote: It's harder to write in the third person but the advantage is you move around better.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Half of what I write is garbage, but if I don't write it down it decomposes in my head.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

quotes.quote: You don't need to wait for inspiration to write. It's easier to be inspired while writing that while not writing...
quotes.author: Josip Novakovich,  Fiction Writer's Workshop

quotes.quote: The shame of being a man - is there any better reason to write?
quotes.author: Gilles Deleuze

quotes.quote: I can't play bridge. I don't play tennis. All those things that people learn, and I admire, there hasn't seemed time for. But what there is time for is looking out the window.
quotes.author: Alice Munro

quotes.quote: Dive again and again into the river of uncertainty. Create in the dark, only then can you recognize the light.
quotes.author: Jyrki Vainonen

quotes.quote: I have always held the old-fashioned opinion that the primary object of work of fiction should be to tell a story.
quotes.author: Wilkie Collins,  The Woman in White

quotes.quote: A bad book is as much of a labor to write as a good one; it comes as sincerely from the author's soul.
quotes.author: Aldous Huxley,  Point Counter Point

quotes.quote: I think imagination is at the heart of everything we do. Scientific discoveries couldn't have happened without imagination. Art, music, and literature couldn't exist without imagination. And so anything that strengthens imagination, and reading certainly does that, can help us for the rest of our lives.
quotes.author: Lloyd Alexander

quotes.quote: People who write fiction, if they had not taken it up, might have become very successful liars.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Read - and be curious. And if somebody says to you: 'Things are this way. You can't change it' - don't believe a word.
quotes.author: Cornelia Funke

quotes.quote: [On writing:] "There's a great quote by Julius Irving that went, 'Being a professional is doing the things you love to do, on the days you don't feel like doing them.'"(One On 1, interview with Budd Mishkin; NY1, March 25, 2007.)
quotes.author: David Halberstam,  Everything They Had: Sports Writing

quotes.quote: I'd like to emphasize that when a reader finishes a great novel, he will immediately begin looking for another. If someone loves your book, it increases the chance that he or she will look at mine. So there is no competition between writers. Another writer's success helps build a larger readership for all of us.
quotes.author: David Farland

quotes.quote: Somebody gets into trouble, then gets out of it again. People love that story. They never get tired of it.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: If I could sum it up in 50 words, I wouldn't have needed to write a whole novel about it.
quotes.author: Patrick Rothfuss

quotes.quote: Second-hand books are wild books, homeless books; they have come together in vast flocks of variegated feather, and have a charm which the domesticated volumes of the library lack. Besides, in this random miscellaneous company we may rub against some complete stranger who will, with luck, turn into the best friend we have in the world.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Street haunting

quotes.quote: take a writer away from his typewriterand all you have leftisthe sicknesswhich started himtypingin thebeginning
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: Membaca dan menulis membuatmu menjadi.
quotes.author: Helvy Tiana Rosa

quotes.quote: Nothing quite has reality for me till I write it all down--revising and embellishing as I go. I'm always waiting for things to be over so I can get home and commit them to paper.
quotes.author: Erica Jong

quotes.quote: I have forced myself to begin writing when I've been utterly exhausted, when I've felt my soul as thin as a playing card...and somehow the activity of writing changes everything.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates

quotes.quote: No book can ever be finished. While working on it we learn just enough to find it immature the moment we turn away from it
quotes.author: Karl Popper

quotes.quote: It's 4:00 in the afternoon and I'm just now putting on clothes. The life of a writer is as free as the pizza I just had delivered is not.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: CLEMENTINE: This is it, Joel. It's going to be gone soon.JOEL: I know.CLEMENTINE: What do we do?JOEL: Enjoy it.
quotes.author: Charlie Kaufman,  Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind: The Shooting Script

quotes.quote: It is a very sad thing that nowadays there is so little useless information.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: At the end of the day your ability to connect with your readers comes down to how you make them feel.
quotes.author: Benjamin J. Carey,  Barefoot in November

quotes.quote: It's not my brain that's writing the book, it's these hands of mine.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: For once the disease of reading has laid upon the system it weakens so that it falls an easy prey to that other scourge which dwells in the ink pot and festers in the quill. The wretch takes to writing.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

quotes.quote: People who read your ideas tend to think that your writings reflect your life.
quotes.author: Henri J.M. Nouwen

quotes.quote: Because even among contrarians, I'm a contrarian. But all of this is just words of bronze, third place rhetoric. What do I really mean when I say we want to shock society into awareness? Do we mean we want more originality and individuality? Less TV, more reading, writing, actual thinking? Less sheep, more shepherd pie? Yes, yes, and a little more pie, please. Oh, and some more sweet tea, too
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Should Have Renamed This

quotes.quote: From that time on, the world was hers for the reading. She would never be lonely again, never miss the lack of intimate friends. Books became her friends and there was one for every mood.
quotes.author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

quotes.quote: Science fiction films are not about science. They are about disaster, which is one of the oldest subjects of art.
quotes.author: Susan Sontag

quotes.quote: I don't think writers are sacred, but words are. They deserve respect. If you get the right ones in the right order, you might nudge the world a little or make a poem that children will speak for you when you are dead.
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard,  The Real Thing: A Play

quotes.quote: To produce a mighty book, you must choose a mighty theme.
quotes.author: Herman Melville

quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

quotes.quote: Writing is an exploration. You start from nothing.
quotes.author: E.L. Doctorow

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

quotes.quote: My pen shall heal, not hurt.
quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery,  Emily Climbs

quotes.quote: I write out of revenge.
quotes.author: William Goldman

quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Crepuscule

quotes.quote: A good story cannot be devised; it has to be distilled.
quotes.author: Raymond Chandler

quotes.quote: Bird by bird, buddy. Just take it bird by bird.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott,  Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

quotes.quote: Books are for nothing but to inspire
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: You've gone far away to a place with no horses and very little grass, and you're studying how to write a story with a happy ending. If you can write that ending for yourself, maybe you can come back.
quotes.author: Jennifer Echols,  Love Story

quotes.quote: The secret is not to write about what you love best, but about what you, alone, love at all.
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.quote: If you have not done things worthy of being written about, at least write things worthy of being read.
quotes.author: Giacomo Casanova

quotes.quote: â€ŽA day in which I don't write leaves a taste of ashes.
quotes.author: Simone de Beauvoir

quotes.quote: A good piece of fiction, in my view, does not offer solutions. Good stories deal with our moral struggles, our uncertainties, our dreams, our blunders, our contradictions, our endless quest for understanding. Good stories do not resolve the mysteries of the human spirit but rather describe and expand up on those mysteries.
quotes.author: Tim O'Brien

quotes.quote: Some of this book--perhaps too much--has been about how I learned to do it. Much of it has been about how you can do it better. The rest of it--and perhaps the best of it--is a permission slip: you can, you should, and if you're brave enough to start, you will. Writing is magic, as much the water of life as any other creative art. The water is free. So drink. Drink and be filled up.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

quotes.quote: Will I have to use a dictionary to read your book?"asked Mrs. Dodypol. "It depends,"says I, "how much you used the dictionary before you read it.
quotes.author: Alexander Theroux,  Darconville's Cat

quotes.quote: Reading is sometimes thought of as a form of escapism, and it's a common turn of phrase to speak of getting lost in a book. But a book can also be where one finds oneself; and when a reader is grasped and held by a book, reading does not feel like an escape from life so much as it feels like an urgent, crucial dimension of life itself.
quotes.author: Rebecca Mead,  My Life in Middlemarch

quotes.quote: Literature is the safe and traditional vehicle through which we learn about the world and pass on values from on generation to the next. Books save lives.
quotes.author: Laurie Anderson

quotes.quote: Beauty is not who you are on the outside, it is the wisdom and time you gave away to save another struggling soul, like you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: If you only write when inspired, you may be a fairly decent poet, but you'll never be a novelist.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: A novel rough draft is like bread dough; you need to beat the crap out of it for it to rise.
quotes.author: Chris Baty,  No Plot? No Problem!: A Low-Stress, High-Velocity Guide to Writing a Novel in 30 Days

quotes.quote: There are people who think that things that happen in fiction do not really happen. These people are wrong.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: I have tried to remove weight, sometimes from people, sometimes from heavenly bodies, sometimes from cities; above all I have tried to remove weight from the structure of stories and from language.
quotes.author: Italo Calvino

quotes.quote: I don't trust men everybody likes. Being nice isn't the same as being good.
quotes.author: Sarah Rees Brennan,  The Demon's Covenant

quotes.quote: Language exists less to record the actual than to liberate the imagination.
quotes.author: Anthony Burgess

quotes.quote: Menulis kembali kenangan masa lalu butuh sebuah keberanian.
quotes.author: Iwan Setyawan,  9 Summers 10 Autumns

quotes.quote: I want to write about people who dream and wait for the night to end, who long for the light so they can hold the ones they love.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  After the Quake

quotes.quote: Don't get me wrong, magic is cool. But a nervous mother singing to her child at night while something moves quietly through the dark outside her house? That's a story. Handled properly, it's more dramatic than any apocalypse or goblin army could ever be.
quotes.author: Patrick Rothfuss

quotes.quote: For a long time now I have tried simply to write the best I can. Sometimes I have good luck and write better than I can.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: You do what you were made to do. Some of us were made to read and write. Thanks be to God.
quotes.author: Nancy M. Malone,  Walking a Literary Labyrinth

quotes.quote: Writing is really just a matter of writing a lot, writing consistently and having faith that you'll continue to get better and better. Sometimes, people think that if they don't display great talent and have some success right away, they won't succeed. But writing is about struggling through and learning and finding out what it is about writing itself that you really love.
quotes.author: Laura Kasischke

quotes.quote: You can write any time people will leave you alone and not interrupt you. Or rather you can if you will be ruthless enough about it. But the best writing is certainly when you are in love.
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: The pen is mightier than the sword!
quotes.author: Edward Bulwer-Lytton

quotes.quote: I am a writer perhaps because I am not a talker.
quotes.author: Gwendolyn Brooks

quotes.quote: I have always been a huge admirer of my own work. I'm one of the funniest and most entertaining writers I know.
quotes.author: Mel Brooks

quotes.quote: From now on I hope always to stay alert, to educate myself as best I can. But lacking this, in Future I will relaxedly turn back to my secret mind to see what it has observed when I thought I was sitting this one out. We never sit anything out.We are cups, constantly and quietly being filled. The trick is, knowing how to tip ourselves over and let the beautiful stuff out.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: It's a bizarre but wonderful feeling, to arrive dead center of a target you didn't even know you were aiming for.
quotes.author: Lois McMaster Bujold

quotes.quote: It was one of the dullest speeches I ever heard. The Agee woman told us for three quarters of an hour how she came to write her beastly book, when a simple apology was all that was required.
quotes.author: P.G. Wodehouse,  The Girl in Blue

quotes.quote: People do not deserve good writing, they are so pleased with bad.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Hold a book in your hand and you're a pilgrim at the gates of a new city.
quotes.author: Anne Michaels,  Fugitive Pieces

quotes.quote: It is really hard to be lonely very long in a world of words. Even if you don't have friends somewhere, you still have language, and it will find you and wrap its little syllables around you and suddenly there will be a story to live in.
quotes.author: Naomi Shihab Nye,  I'll Ask You Three Times, Are You OK?: Tales of Driving and Being Driven

quotes.quote: If I'm going to sing like someone else, then I don't need to sing at all.
quotes.author: Billie Holiday

quotes.quote: This is no book. Whoever touches this touches a man.
quotes.author: Ezra Pound

quotes.author: Hillary Frank,  I Can't Tell You

quotes.author: Adrienne Rich

quotes.quote: Life is painful and disappointing. It is useless, therefore, to write new realistic novels. We generally know where we stand in relation to reality and don't care to know any more.
quotes.author: Michel Houellebecq,  H.P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life

quotes.quote: if a book isn't self-explanatory, then it isn't worth reading.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

quotes.quote: On the whole, stories don't write themselves.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Fragile Things: Short Fictions and Wonders

quotes.quote: Writing means not just staring ugliness in the face, but finding a way to embrace  it.
quotes.author: Veronica Roth

quotes.quote: I see all of us reading ourselves away from ourselves,  straining in circles of light to find more light until the line of words becomes a trail of crumbs that we follow across a page of fresh snow
quotes.author: Billy Collins,  Sailing Alone Around the Room: New and Selected Poems

quotes.quote: Wordplay hides a key to reality that the dictionary tries in vain to lock inside every free word.
quotes.author: Julio CortÃ¡zar,  Around the Day in Eighty Worlds

quotes.quote: I'm up for the Julius Caesar Author of the Year Award this year. I'm tremendously proud, considering Caesar is the guy who burned down the Library of Alexandria.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: The writer can grow as a person or he can shrink. ... His curiosity, his reaction to life must not diminish. The fatal thing is to shrink, to be interested in less, sympathetic to less, desiccating to the point where life itself loses its flavor, and one's passion for human understanding changes to weariness and distaste.
quotes.author: Norman Mailer

quotes.quote: You have what I can afford to give. You are a panhandler, begging for anything, and I am the man walking briskly by, tossing a quarter or so into your paper cup. I can afford to give you this. This does not break me.
quotes.author: Dave Eggers,  A Heartbreaking Work of Staggering Genius

quotes.quote: Why can't I write something that would awake the dead? That pursuit is what burns most deeply.
quotes.author: Patti Smith,  Just Kids

quotes.quote: Writing's a lot like cooking. Sometimes the cake won't rise, no matter what you do, and every now and again the cake tastes better than you ever could have dreamed it would.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Fragile Things: Short Fictions and Wonders

quotes.quote: In the ordinary jumble of my literary drawer, I sometimes find texts I wrote ten, fifteen, or even more years ago. And many of them seem to me written by a stranger: I simply do not recognize myself in them. There was a person who wrote them, and it was I. I experienced them, but it was in another life, from which I just woke up, as if from someone else's dream.
quotes.author: Fernando Pessoa,  The Book of Disquiet

quotes.quote: Like flies in amber, like corpses frozen in ice, that which according to the laws of nature should pass away is, by the miracle of ink on paper, preserved. It is a kind of magic. As one tends the graves of the dead, so I tend the books. And every day I open a volume or two, read a few lines or pages, allow the voices of the forgotten dead to resonate inside my head.
quotes.author: Diane Setterfield,  The Thirteenth Tale

quotes.quote: Doubt is a question mark; faith is an exclamation point. The most compelling, believable, realistic stories have included them both.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I had to learn to live without you and I couldn't make sense of it, because I left so much of me inside of you.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Writing is prayer.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.quote: It's a wonderful thing to be able to create your own world whenever you want to.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: All the stories I would like to write persecute me. When I am in my chamber, it seems as if they are all around me, like little devils, and while one tugs at my ear, another tweaks my nose, and each says to me, 'Sir, write me, I am beautiful.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

quotes.quote: For any writer who wants to keep a journal, be alive to everything, not just to what you're feeling, but also to your pets, to flowers, to what you're reading.
quotes.author: May Sarton

quotes.quote: Every reader finds himself. The writer's work is merely a kind of optical instrument that makes it possible for the reader to discern what, without this book, he would perhaps never have seen in himself.
quotes.author: Marcel Proust,  Time Regained

quotes.quote: I believe more in the scissors than I do in the pencil.
quotes.author: Truman Capote

quotes.quote: Writing a long and substantial book is like having a friend and companion at your side, to whom you can always turn for comfort and amusement, and whose society becomes more attractive as a new and widening field of interest is lighted in the mind.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: One wants to tell a story, like Scheherezade, in order not to die. It's one of the oldest urges in mankind. It's a way of stalling death.
quotes.author: Carlos Fuentes

quotes.quote: Rem tene, verba sequentur: grasp the subject, and the words will follow. This, I believe, is the opposite of what happens with poetry, which is more a case of verba tene, res sequenter: grasp the words, and the subject will follow.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco,  Postscript to the Name of the Rose

quotes.quote: Writing- the profession in which you stare at a computer screen, stare out the window, type a few words, then curse repeatedly.
quotes.author: Drew Goodman

quotes.quote: Very often we write down a sentence too early, then another too late; what we have to do is write it down at the proper time, otherwise it's lost.
quotes.author: Thomas Bernhard,  Concrete

quotes.quote: If your wife locks you out of the house, you don't have a problem with your door.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott,  Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

quotes.quote: if you think they didn't go crazy in tiny rooms just like you're doing now without women without food without hope then you're not ready.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  Love is a Dog from Hell

quotes.quote: A big enough artist, I say, can eat anything, must eat everything and then alchemize it. Only the feeble writer is afraid of expansion.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin,  The Diary of AnaÃ¯s Nin, Vol. 1: 1931-1934

quotes.quote: Keep reminding yourself that literature is one of the saddest roads that leads to everything.
quotes.author: AndrÃ© Breton

quotes.quote: Language is a finding-place not a hiding place.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: Only amateurs say that they write for their own amusement. Writing is not an amusing occupation. It is a combination of ditch-digging, mountain-climbing, treadmill and childbirth. Writing may be interesting, absorbing, exhilarating, racking, relieving. But amusing? Never!
quotes.author: Edna Ferber

quotes.quote: If you really want to be a writer, nobody can stop you -- and if you don't, nobody can help you.
quotes.author: Alma Alexander

quotes.quote: The ideal art, the noblest of art: working with the complexities of life, refusing to simplify, to "overcome"doubt.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates,  The Journal of Joyce Carol Oates: 1973-1982

quotes.quote: Convince yourself that you are working in clay, not marble, on paper not eternal bronze: Let that first sentence be as stupid as it wishes.
quotes.author: Jacques Barzun

quotes.quote: One should never use exclamation points in writing. It is like laughing at your own joke.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I long ago abandoned myself to a blind lust for the written word. Literature is my sandbox. In it I play, build my forts and castles, spend glorious time.
quotes.author: Rabih Alameddine,  An Unnecessary Woman

quotes.quote: She needed the chaos within her in order to discover the extraordinary no man could ever reach.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Everyone in the South has no time for reading because they are all too busy writing.
quotes.author: William Faulkner

quotes.quote: A book comes and says, 'Write me.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: Es kommt nicht darauf an, wie eine Geschichte anfÃ¤ngt. Auch nicht darauf, wie sie aufhÃ¶rt. Sondern auf das, was dazwischen passiert.
quotes.author: Walter Moers,  Die Stadt der TrÃ¤umenden BÃ¼cher

quotes.quote: [Science fiction is] out in the mainstream now. You can tell by the way mainstream literary authors pillage SF while denying they're writing it!
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: For this quiet, unprepossessing, passive man who has no garden in front of his subsidised flat, books are like flowers. He loves to line them up on the shelf in multicoloured rows: he watches over each of them with an old-fashioned gardener's delight, holds them like fragile objects in his thin, bloodless hands.
quotes.author: Stefan Zweig,  The Post-Office Girl

quotes.quote: There is only one genre in fiction, the genre is called book.
quotes.author: Matt Haig,  The Humans

quotes.quote: Writing is not a matter of time, but a matter or of space. If you don't keep space in your head for writing, you won't write even if you have the time.
quotes.author: Katerina Stoykova Klemer

quotes.quote: Green in nature is one thing, green in literature another. Nature and letters seem to have a natural antipathy; bring them together and they tear each other to pieces.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

quotes.quote: Writing poetry and reading books causes brain damage.
quotes.author: Pat Conroy,  Beach Music

quotes.quote: I felt like poisoning a monk.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco,  Postscript to the Name of the Rose

quotes.quote: I have found, in short, from reading my own writing, that my subject in fiction is the action of grace in territory largely held by the devil.I have also found that what I write is read by an audience which puts little stock either in grace or the devil. You discover your audience at the same time and in the same way that you discover your subject, but it is an added blow.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

quotes.quote: Everywhere I go, I am asked if I think university stifles writers. My opinion is that it doesn't stifle enough of them.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: When I started writingI was a sick teenagedfuck inside who partlythought I was the newMarquis de Sade, a bodydoomed to communicatewith Satan who was us-ing my sickness as hishome away from home,and there's your proof.
quotes.author: Dennis Cooper

quotes.quote: When I stop working the rest of the day is posthumous. I'm only really alive when I'm writing.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams

quotes.quote: Write to your heart's content and by all means, have fun with your creation. It's your moment to do absolutely anything within those pages.
quotes.author: Jennifer Murgia

quotes.quote: First draft: let it run. Turn all the knobs up to 11. Second draft: hell. Cut it down and cut it into shape. Third draft: comb its nose and blow its hair. I usually find that most of the book will have handed itself to me on that first draft.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: ...(W)here there's drama, there's crap.
quotes.author: Jincy Willett,  The Writing Class

quotes.quote: In the planning stage of a book, don't plan the ending. It has to be earned by all that will go before it.
quotes.author: Rose Tremain

quotes.quote: He drove his mind into the abyss where poetry is written.
quotes.author: George Orwell,  Keep the Aspidistra Flying

quotes.quote: The author should die once he has finished writing. So as not to trouble the path of the text.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco,  Postscript to the Name of the Rose

quotes.quote: Just start the sentence...and see what happens. This is how we write.
quotes.author: Jincy Willett,  The Writing Class

quotes.quote: I've always considered writing the most hateful kind of work. I suspect it's a bit like fucking -- which is fun only for amateurs. Old whores don't do much giggling. Nothing is fun when you have to do it -- over and over, again and again...
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson,  The Great Shark Hunt: Strange Tales from a Strange Time

quotes.quote: Chris Claremont once said of Alan Moore, "if he could plot, we'd all have to get together and kill him."Which utterly misses the most compelling part of Alan's writing, the way he develops and expresses ideas and character. Plot does not define story. Plot is the framework within which ideas are explored and personalities and relationships are unfolded.
quotes.author: Warren Ellis

quotes.quote: (W)hat I write when I force myself is generally just as good as what I write when I'm feeling inspired. It's mainly a matter of forcing yourself to write.
quotes.author: Tom Wolfe

quotes.quote: Let us record the atoms as they fall upon the mind in the order in which they fall, let us trace the pattern, however disconnected and incoherent in appearance, which each sight or incident scores upon the consciousness. Let us not take it for granted that life exists more fully in what is commonly thought big than in what is commonly thought small.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  The Common Reader

quotes.quote: I cringe when critics say I'm a master of the popular novel. What's an unpopular novel?
quotes.author: Irwin Shaw

quotes.quote: Personally, I think so-called "common language"is more interesting and apropos than "proper English"; it's passionate and powerful in ways that "wherefore art thou ass and thy elbow"just isn't.
quotes.author: J.R. Ward,  The Black Dagger Brotherhood: An Insider's Guide

quotes.quote: Read to escape reality . . . Write to embrace it.
quotes.author: Stephanie Connolly

quotes.quote: [A young adult novel] ends not with happily ever after, but at a new beginning, with the sense of a lot of life yet to be lived.
quotes.author: Richard Peck

quotes.quote: The very first thing I tell my new students on the first day of a workshop is that good writing is about telling the truth. We are a species that needs and wants to understand who we are. Sheep lice do not seem to share this longing, which is one reason they write so very little. But we do. We have so much we want to say and figure out.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: Writer's block is real. It happens. Some days you sit down at theold typewriter, put your fingers on the keys, and nothing popsinto your head. Blanko. Nada. El nothingissimo. What you dowhen this happens is what separates you from the one-of-thesedays-I'm-gonna-write-a-book crowd.
quotes.author: James N. Frey,  How to Write a Damn Good Novel: A Step-by-Step No Nonsense Guide to Dramatic Storytelling

quotes.quote: To make a deliberate falsification for personal gain is the last, worst depth to which either scholar or artist can descend in work or life.(Letter to Muriel St. Clare Byrne, 8 September 1935)
quotes.author: Dorothy L. Sayers,  The Letters of Dorothy L. Sayers. Vol. 1, 1899-1936: The Making of a Detective Novelist

quotes.quote: The best ideas will eat at you for days, maybe even weeks, until something, some incident, some impulse, triggers you to finally express them.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The aim of science is to discover and illuminate truth. And that, I take it, is the aim of literature, whether biography or history... It seems to me, then, that there can be no separate literature of science.
quotes.author: Rachel Carson

quotes.quote: Its dark and I'm reading my scars because our moments remind me of where I should be.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Witness also that when we talk about literature, we do so in the present tense. When we speak of the dead, we are not so kind.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: When you can write music that endures, bravo. Until then, keep quiet and study the work of those who can.
quotes.author: Jennifer Donnelly,  Revolution

quotes.quote: ...words have been all my life, all my life--this need is like the Spider's need who carries before her a huge Burden of Silk which she must spin out--the silk is her life, her home, her safety--her food and drink too--and if it is attacked or pulled down, why, what can she do but make more, spin afresh, design anew....
quotes.author: A.S. Byatt,  Possession

quotes.quote: In Hollywood, no one knows anything.
quotes.author: William Goldman

quotes.quote: The ability to dream is all I have to give. That is my responsibility; that is my burden. And even I grow tired.
quotes.author: Harlan Ellison,  Stalking the Nightmare

quotes.quote: (An unhappy childhood was not) an unsuitable preparation for my future, in that it demanded a constant wariness, the habit of observation, and the attendance on moods and tempers; the noting of discrepancies between speech and action; a certain reserve of demeanour; and automatic suspicion of sudden favours.
quotes.author: Rudyard Kipling,  Something of Myself

quotes.quote: Writing, the art of communicating thoughts to the mind through the eye, is the great invention of the world...enabling us to converse with the dead, the absent, and the unborn, at all distances of time and space.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln,  Speeches And Letters Of Abraham Lincoln, 1832 1865

quotes.quote: God pity the poor novelist.
quotes.author: Steven Millhauser,  Edwin Mullhouse: The Life and Death of an American Writer 1943-1954 by Jeffrey Cartwright

quotes.quote: When you're a writer, the question people always ask you is, "Where do you get your ideas?"Writers hate this question. It's like asking Humphrey Bogart in The African Queen, "Where do you get your leeches?"You don't get ideas. Ideas get you.
quotes.author: Connie Willis

quotes.quote: Inspirations never go in for long engagements; they demand immediate marriage to action.
quotes.author: Brendan Francis Brown

quotes.quote: Fiction that adds up, that suggests a "logical consistency,"or an explanation of some kind, is surely second-rate fiction; for the truth of life is its mystery.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates,  The Journal of Joyce Carol Oates: 1973-1982

quotes.quote: a good writer should draw the reader in by starting in the middle of the story with a hook, then go back and fill in what happened before the hook. Once you have the reader hooked, you can write whatever you want as you slowly reel them in.
quotes.author: Roland Smith,  Peak

quotes.quote: My life looked good on paper - where, in fact, almost all of it was being lived.
quotes.author: Martin Amis,  Experience: A Memoir

quotes.quote: But the purpose of a story is to teach and to please at once, and what it teaches is how to recognize the snares of the world.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

quotes.quote: Books, for me, are a home. Books don't make a home - they are one, in the sense that just as you do with a door, you open a book, and you go inside. Inside there is a different kind of time and space. There is warmth there too - a hearth. I sit down with a book and I am warm.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Why Be Happy When You Could Be Normal?

quotes.quote: A writer always writes.
quotes.author: Don Roff

quotes.quote: You not only are hunted by others, you unknowingly hunt yourself.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

quotes.quote: You're not a bad person, you're just a little bit different and I'm a sucker for that.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Since there is no real silence, Silence will contain all the sounds, All the words, all the languages, All knowledge, all memory.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic

quotes.quote: But still I feel I waste a lot of time leaning on my elbow and thinking to myself, "alright sucker, now what?
quotes.author: Peter S. Beagle

quotes.quote: As with all other aspects of the narrative art, you will improve with practice, but practice will never make you perfect. Why should it? What fun would that be?
quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.quote: We write by the light of every story we have ever read.
quotes.author: Richard Peck

quotes.quote: I write because I cannot NOT write.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«

quotes.quote: The glory of a good tale is that it is limitless and fluid; a good tale belongs to each reader in its own particular way.
quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.quote: Have regrets. They are fuel. On the page they flare into desire.
quotes.author: Geoff Dyer

quotes.quote: Tell the story as if it were only of interest to the small circle of your characters, of which you may be one. There is no other way to put life into the story.
quotes.author: Horacio Quiroga

quotes.quote: I don't teach writing. I teach patience. Toughness. Stubbornness. The willingness to fail. I teach the life. The odd thing is most of the things that stop an inexperienced writer are so far from the truth as to be nearly beside the point. When you feel glosbal doubt about your talent, that is your talent. People who have no talent don't have any doubt.
quotes.author: Richard Bausch

quotes.quote: Maybe love was meant to save us from ourselves.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: We aren't suggesting that mental instability or unhappiness makes one a better poet, or a poet at all; and contrary to the romantic notion of the artist suffering for his or her work, we think these writers achieved brilliance in spite of their suffering, not because of it.
quotes.author: Dorianne Laux,  The Poet's Companion: A Guide To The Pleasures Of Writing Poetry

quotes.quote: Even at the time--twenty years old--I said to myself: better to go hungry, to go to prison, to be a tramp, than to sit at an office desk ten hours a day. There is no particular daring in this vow, but I have not broken it and shall not do so. The wisdom of my grandfathers sat in my head: we are born for the pleasure of work, fighting, love, we are born for that and nothing else. (Guy de Maupassant)
quotes.author: Isaac Babel,  Red Cavalry and Other Stories

quotes.quote: Ideas come at any moment -- except when you demand them. Most ideas come while I'm physically active, at the gym, with friends, gardening, so I always carry pen and paper.My first draft is always written in longhand. But once the first dozen chapters, more like short stories, are written, then momentum builds until I can't leave the project until it's done.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk

quotes.quote: In your hands winteris a book with cloud pagesthat snow pearls of love.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: Writing, then, was a substitute for myself: if you don't love me, love my writing & love me for my writing. It is also much more: a way of ordering and reordering the chaos of experience.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: To achieve lasting literature, fictional or factual, a writer needs perceptive vision, absorptive capacity, and creative strength.
quotes.author: Lawrence Clark Powell

quotes.quote: My goal is to write every day. I say it is my ideal. I am careful not to pass judgment or create anxiety if I do not do it. No one lives up to his ideal.
quotes.author: Natalie Goldberg

quotes.quote: Sir,' said Stephen, 'I read novels with the utmost pertinacity. I look upon them--I look upon good novels--as a very valuable part of literature, conveying more exact and finely-distinguished knowledge of the human heart and mind than almost any other, with greater breadth and depth and fewer constraints.
quotes.author: Patrick O'Brian,  The Nutmeg of Consolation

quotes.quote: Your current circumstances are part of your redemption story He is writing.
quotes.author: Evinda Lepins

quotes.quote: I know how you feel because I've been there too. I've hated and I've loved. I've seen my demons root and crawl and my angels branch and soar. I've died within myself and lived a thousand different lives. I too fight the same war and I too am drowning in the puddles of self-consciousness this world created.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: ... a good idea always attracts other good ideas.
quotes.author: Patrick Ness

quotes.quote: There are very few innocent sentences in writing.
quotes.author: David Foster Wallace

quotes.quote: Writing comics? Still the best job in the world. I sit around all day making shit up and see it illustrated, in 99% of cases, exactly as I imagined it -- if not better. I've been doing this a long time now, and I'm going to do it until I die. Which probably won't be long, given the constant insane deadline pressure.
quotes.author: Warren Ellis

quotes.quote: Every man with a bellyful of the classics is an enemy to the human race
quotes.author: Henry Miller

quotes.quote: If the story you're telling, is the story you're telling, you're in deep shit.
quotes.author: Robert McKee,  Story: Style, Structure, Substance, and the Principles of Screenwriting

quotes.quote: To those who care about punctuation, a sentence such as "Thank God its Friday"(without the apostrophe) rouses feelings not only of despair but of violence. The confusion of the possessive "its"(no apostrophe) with the contractive "it's"(with apostrophe) is an unequivocal signal of illiteracy and sets off a Pavlovian "kill"response in the average stickler.
quotes.author: Lynne Truss,  Eats, Shoots & Leaves: The Zero Tolerance Approach to Punctuation

quotes.quote: Fueled by my inspiration, I ran across the room to steal the cup of coffee the bookshelf had taken prisoner. Lapping the black watery brew like a hyena, I tossed the empty cup aside. I then returned to the chair to continue my divine act of creation. Hot blood swished in my head as my mighty pen stole across the page.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: He's an indulgent sort of man......With a quick lip and a fierce tongue, the sort of tongue that draws you in with charm and words of praise, awkward silences and desperate worships.
quotes.author: Coco J. Ginger

quotes.quote: You have to find your own shtick. A Picasso always looks like Picasso painted it. Hemingway always sounds like Hemingway. A Beethoven symphony always sounds like a Beethoven symphony. Part of being a master is learning how to sing in nobody else's voice but your own.
quotes.author: Hugh MacLeod,  Ignore Everybody: and 39 Other Keys to Creativity

quotes.quote: Writers don't write from experience, although many are hesitant to admit that they don't. ...If you wrote from experience, you'd get maybe one book, maybe three poems. Writers write from empathy.
quotes.author: Nikki Giovanni

quotes.quote: It is simply wrong to begin with a theme, symbol or other abstract unifying agent, and then try to force characters and events to conform to it.
quotes.author: Thomas Pynchon,  Slow Learner: Early Stories

quotes.quote: Writing may or may not be your salvation; it might or might not be your destiny. But that does not matter. What matters right now are the words, one after another. Find the next word. Write it down.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: If this typewriter can't do it, then fuck it, it can't be done.
quotes.author: Tom Robbins,  Still Life with Woodpecker

quotes.quote: The text you write must prove to me that it desires me. This proof exists: it is writing. Writing is: the science of the various blisses of language, its Kama Sutra (this science has but one treatise: writing itself).
quotes.author: Roland Barthes,  The Pleasure of the Text

quotes.quote: How can you write if you can't cry?
quotes.author: Ring Lardner

quotes.quote: ...there were certain chapters when I stopped writing, saw the domestic situation I was in and thought, "I don't want to face this world, let's get back to the hellish one I'm imagining.
quotes.author: Alasdair Gray

quotes.quote: If you`re wondering how you`ll find time, it means you don`t really want to read. Because nobody`s ever got time. Children certainly haven`t, nor have teenagers or grown-ups. Life always gets in the way. <...>Time to read is always time stolen. <...>Stolen from what? From the tyranny of living.'- p.125
quotes.author: Daniel Pennac

quotes.quote: I'm not ashamed of heroic ambitions. If man and woman can only dance upon this earth for a few countable turns of the sun... let each of us be an Artemis, Odysseus, or Zeus... Aphrodite to the extent of the will of each one.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: I never had any doubts about my abilities. I knew I could write. I just had to figure out how to eat while doing this.[Cormac McCarthy's Venomous Fiction, New York Times, April 19, 1992]
quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy

quotes.quote: With my career I want to either make something or make an impact. Writers both make something, and make an impact.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: Writers cannot choose their own mood: with them it is not always hide-tide, nor --thank Heaven!--always Storm.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«

quotes.quote: When the last dime is gone, I'll sit on the curb outside with a pencil and a ten cent notebook and start the whole thing over again.
quotes.author: Preston Sturges

quotes.quote: Writing is like going underwater - thank you for being there when I come back up.
quotes.author: Ali Shaw,  The Girl With Glass Feet

quotes.quote: The mind travels faster than the pen; consequently, writing becomes a question of learning to make occasional wing shots, bringing down the bird of thought as it flashes by. A writer is a gunner, sometimes waiting in the blind for something to come in, sometimes roaming the countryside hoping to scare something up.
quotes.author: E.B. White,  The Elements of Style

quotes.quote: not to find out new principles, or new arguments, never before thought of . . . but to place before mankind the common sense of the subject, in terms so plain and firm as to command their assent, and to justify ourselves in the independent stand we are compelled to take.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson,  The Declaration of Independence

quotes.quote: I confess to wincing every so often at a poorly chosen word, a mangled sentence, an expression of emotion that seems indulgent or overly practiced. I have the urge to cut the book by fifty pages or so, possessed as I am with a keener appreciation for brevity.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: The job of the first eight pages is not to have the reader want to throw the book at the wall, during the first eight pages.
quotes.author: David Foster Wallace

quotes.quote: Hello, I'm Shellie's new boyfriend and I'm out of my mind. If you so much as talk to her or even think her name, I'll cut you in ways that'll make you useless to a woman.
quotes.author: Frank Miller,  Sin City, Vol. 3: The Big Fat Kill

quotes.quote: If you want to get rich from writing, write the sort of thing that's read by persons who move their lips when they're reading to themselves.
quotes.author: Don Marquis

quotes.quote: My worst flaw is that I tell secrets, my own and everybody else's.
quotes.author: Isabel Allende,  My Invented Country: A Nostalgic Journey Through Chile

quotes.quote: Tell me this--if you knew you would be poor as a church mouse all your life--if you knew you'd never have a line published--would you still go on writing--would you?''Of course I would,' said Emily disdainfully. 'Why, I have to write--I can't help it at times--I've just got to.
quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery,  Emily of New Moon

quotes.quote: it's good for you to write down your thoughts. It'stherapeutic because it forces you to slow down and think aboutlife.
quotes.author: Katie Kacvinsky,  Awaken

quotes.quote: Menjadi penulis adalah sebuah perjalanan panjang, yang tidak selalu diisi oleh hal-hal yang menyenangkan. Akan selalu ada kritik, akan selalu ada komentar negatif, akan selalu ada kesalahan. Yang terpenting adalah kita belajar dari kesalahan-kesalahan tersebut dan bangkit untuk menggapai mimpi kita.
quotes.author: Winna Efendi,  Draf 1: Taktik Menulis Fiksi Pertamamu

quotes.quote: The main thing is to writefor the joy of it. Cultivate a work-lustthat imagines its haven like your hands at nightdreaming the sun in the sunspot of a breast.You are fasted now, light-headed, dangerous.Take off from here.
quotes.author: Seamus Heaney,  Station Island

quotes.quote: Language is the mother, not the handmaiden, of thought; words will tell you things you never thought or felt before.
quotes.author: W.H. Auden

quotes.quote: Scribbled secret notebooks, and wild typewritten pages, for yr own joy
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac

quotes.quote: It has been well said that an author who expects results from a first novel is in a position similar to that of a man who drops a rose petal down the Grand Canyon of Arizona and listens for the echo.
quotes.author: P.G. Wodehouse,  Cocktail Time

quotes.quote: Starting over can be the scariest thing in the entire world, whether it's leaving a lover, a school, a team, a friend or anything else that feels like a core part of our identity but when your gut is telling you that something here isn't right or feels unsafe, I really want you to listen and trust in that voice.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: Hope without love is hopeless.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

quotes.quote: Write to your fear.
quotes.author: Dorothy Allison

quotes.quote: When writing goes painfully, when it's hideously difficult, and one feels real despair (ah, the despair, silly as it is, is real!)-then naturally one ought to continue with the work; it would be cowardly to retreat. But when writing goes smoothly-why then one certainly should keep on working, since it would be stupid to stop. Consequently one is always writing or should be writing.
quotes.author: Joyce Carol Oates

quotes.quote: Most of the writers I know work every day, in obscurity and close to poverty, trying to say one thing well and true. Day in, day out, they labor to find their voice, to learn their trade, to understand nuance and pace. And then, facing a sea of rejections, they hear about something like Barbara Bush's dog getting a book deal.
quotes.author: Timothy Egan

quotes.quote: Procrastination is opportunity's natural assassin.
quotes.author: Victor Kiam

quotes.quote: Writing's funny, it's like walking down a hall in the dark looking for the light switch, and suddenly you find it, flip it on, and then you discover the hallway you passed through is papered with the novel you've written.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quotes.quote: No harm's done to history by making it something someone would want to read."(The Course of Human Events, NEH Jefferson Lecture in the Humanities 2003)
quotes.author: David McCullough

quotes.quote: In the glad old days, before the rise of modern morbidities...it used to be thought a disadvantage to be misunderstood.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton,  Heretics

quotes.quote: You can't judge a book by it's cover but you can sure sell a bunch of books if you have a good one.
quotes.author: Jayce O'Neal

quotes.quote: I learned to dream through reading, learned to create dreams through writing, and learned to develop dreamers through teaching. I shall always be a dreamer.
quotes.author: Sharon M. Draper

quotes.quote: Old words are reborn with new faces.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Never start with a clear idea of storyline. Instead, commence blindly, with a vague notion of trying to include a reference to your favourite band, gift shop, or chocolate bar.
quotes.author: Alan C. Martin

quotes.quote: It's not the despair, Laura. I can take the despair. It's the hope I can't stand. ~ Brian Stimpson, Clockwise
quotes.author: John Cleese

quotes.quote: I do believe that characters in novels belong to their writers and their readers pretty equally. I've learned a lot of things about the characters I write from people who read about them. Readers expand them in ways I don't think of and take them to places I can't go.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares

quotes.quote: Failure is usually boring. It is the credible but unrealized threat of failure that is interesting.
quotes.author: Robin D. Laws

quotes.quote: One of the convenient things about literature is that, despite copyrights [...] a book belongs to the reader as well as to the writer.
quotes.author: Anne Fadiman,  At Large and at Small: Familiar Essays

quotes.quote: Beneath my eyes opens -- a book; I see to the bottom; the heart -- I see to the depths. I know what loves are trembling into fire; how jealousy shoots its green flashes hither and thither; how intricately love crosses love; love makes knots; love brutally tears them apart. I have been knotted; I have been torn apart.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  The Waves

quotes.quote: There are a large number of people in the room, but one is unaware of them. They are in the books. At times they move among the pages, like sleepers turning over between two dreams. Ah, how good it is to be among people who are reading.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  The Notebooks of Malte Laurids Brigge

quotes.quote: I believe in hope, in what is something called 'radical hope.' I believe there is hope for all of us, even amid the suffering. And that's why I write fiction, probaby. It's my attempt to keep that fragile strand of radical hope, to buld a fire in the darkness.r
quotes.author: John Green

quotes.quote: I read anything that's going to be interesting. But you don't know what it is until you've read it. Somewhere in a book on the history of false teeth there'll be the making of a novel.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: It's often a matter of sitting in front of the computer and worrying. It's what writing comes down to--worrying that things aren't going to work out.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini

quotes.quote: Writing is an affair of yearning for great voyages and hauling on frayed ropes.
quotes.author: Israel Shenker

quotes.quote: I write only when inspiration strikes. Fortunately it strikes every morning at nine o'clock sharp.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: Writing comes more easily if you have something to say.
quotes.author: Sholem Asch

quotes.quote: When you reduce a woman to writing, she makes you think of a thousand other women
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: Would you like to know the great drama of my life? It is that I have put my genius into my life...I have put only my talent into my works.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: My perfect day is sitting in a room with some blank paper. That's heaven. That's gold and anything else is just a waste of time.
quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy

quotes.quote: A great memory does not make a mind, any more than a dictionary is a piece of literature.
quotes.author: John Henry Newman

quotes.quote: It was only after two years' work that it occurred to me that I was a writer. I had no particular expectation that the novel would ever be published, because it was sort of a mess. It was only when I found myself writing things I didn't realise I knew that I said, 'I'm a writer now.' The novel had become an incentive to deeper thinking. That's really what writing is--an intense form of thought.
quotes.author: Don DeLillo

quotes.quote: How could I live above the water or breathe under it. How could I swim in darkness consumed in an ocean of you? Falling or flying towards you, losing or finding myself in you and beauty was never the word to catch all that you are. For now I know the means of the infinite and it all starts and ends with you.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: Unless their use by readers bring them to life, books are indeed dead things.
quotes.author: Lawrence Clark Powell

quotes.quote: At the end of the day I went to this place where your memories left footsteps on my skin and the breath of your touch stained my desire. Yea, it was one of those nights where I needed you the most.
quotes.author: Robert M. Drake

quotes.quote: It takes writing a billion bad words before you get to the good ones.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: Who you are contributes to your poetry in a number of important ways, but you shouldn't identify with your poems so closely that when they are cut, you're the one that bleeds.
quotes.author: Dorianne Laux,  The Poet's Companion: A Guide To The Pleasures Of Writing Poetry

quotes.quote: The true poem rests between the words.
quotes.author: Vanna Bonta,  Shades Of The World

quotes.quote: I use a whole lot of half-assed semicolons; there was one of them just now; that was a semicolon after 'semicolons,' and another one after 'now.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin

quotes.quote: I writeNotFor the sake of gloryNot For the sake of fameNotFor the sake of successBut for the sake of my soul
quotes.author: Beth Nimmo,  Rachel's Tears: The Spiritual Journey of Columbine Martyr Rachel Scott

quotes.quote: I bet there are a lot of women out there who want to sleep with a guy who reads. And being the head of the reading foundation, I'm very well endowed.
quotes.author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

quotes.quote: And ever, as the story drainedThe wells of fancy dry,And faintly strove that weary oneTo put the subject by,"The rest next time--""It is next time!"The Happy voice cry.Thus grew the tale of Wonderland
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice's Adventures in Wonderland & Through the Looking-Glass

quotes.quote: I am writing in the garden. To write as one should of a garden one must write not outside it or merely somewhere near it, but in the garden.
quotes.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett

quotes.quote: If I'm going to write a book every American will want to read, it's got to have lots of pictures. Those pictures must also move, and all the words in the book must be spoken and available audibly for all the readers to hear as they watch.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

quotes.quote: Rich will be my life if I can keep my memories full and brimming, and record them on clear-eyed mornings while I set joyously to work setting pen to holy craft.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: Behind the perfection of a man's style, must lie the passion of a man's soul.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  Reviews

quotes.quote: We keep quiet about what we read. Our enjoyment of a book remains a jealously guarded secret. Perhaps because there`s no need to talk, or because it takes time to distill what we've read before we can say anything. Silence is our guarantee of intimacy. We might have finished reading but we`re still livingthe book.
quotes.author: Daniel Pennac
